newsitem.title: USA: Upbeat tone lures corp players into debt arena.
newsitem.headline: Upbeat tone lures corp players into debt arena.

text.p: An upbeat tone continued to grab hold of the corporate bond primary market as sharply lower U.S. Treasury yields lured more issuers to market, dealers said.
"We continue to hear names in the market...issuers continue to take advantage of the interest rate environment," one syndicate source said.
So far Thursday, PSI Energy issued $100 million Baa1/BBB-plus 10-year debentures to yield 35 basis points over comparable U.S. Treasuries.
JP Morgan Securities is expected to underwrite a $200 million 10-year debt offering for Corestates Financial, dealers said. Price talk is seen at 60 to 62 basis points over Treasuries.
Among preferred issues, Allstate is expected to issue $350 million via Goldman Sachs. Price talk is in the 8.0 percent arena, according to sources.
Turning to the private placement arena, Newport News Shipbuilding & Dry Dock Co, a unit of Tenneco, is expected to come to market with a $400 million two-tranche deal via JP Morgan Securities.
